handoff.agents.title: # AGENTS.md · Package {pbi} · {title} v{version}
handoff.agents.intro: The package has no screen images. Wireflow board: {board}. Each screen has a route in the package prototype (`{prototype}`), a text "how to reach", runnable steps, and a Figma link to its card on the wireflow board. Open only the file the task needs; do not read the whole folder.
handoff.agents.ba: | BA: write or review the spec | `spec/index.md` (scope, unit table, "needs confirmation") → `spec/<code>.md` of the unit → `spec/flows.md` when the flow matters → `requirements/checklist-feature.csv` |
handoff.agents.qc: | QC: write and run test cases | `requirements/checklist-qc.csv` (filter by unit code, flow) → `spec/flows.md` (steps, route, demo link) → `screens/screens.json` for the route and steps to a screen |
handoff.agents.dev: | Dev: build a unit | `spec/<code>.md` (requirements, design notes: components, tokens, states) → `screens/screens.json` (pin selectors, route) → {last} |
handoff.agents.design: | Design, wireflow | `spec/flows.md` or `requirements/flows.json` → Figma link of each screen in `screens/screens.json` |
handoff.agents.view1: - Open the prototype over HTTP from the package folder (see README), go to the screen's `route` in `screens/screens.json`, then follow `how` (text) or run `steps` (Playwright: goto, click, fill, type, press, wait…; `F|`, `E|` mark an element inside an iframe).
handoff.agents.view2: - A screen with `after`: run the steps of that screen first (same flow, no reload). Routes with ids made at run time are valid only in that run: follow `how`/`steps`, do not open the route directly.
handoff.agents.view3: - To see a screen without running the prototype: open its `figma` link (wireflow board, captured at the package version).
handoff.agents.view4: - Pin `S30-2` = screen S30, pin 2 (selector in `screens.json`; style and tokens in the "Design notes" table of `spec/<code>.md`).
handoff.agents.archived: - Replaced or removed units ({ids}) are in `spec/{file}`; read only for traceability.
handoff.agents.tokens: Token source: {ds} (tokens `{prefix}*`). Local components of the app use the prefix `{local}` (listed in `spec/index.md`).
handoff.agents.note: Note: the prototype is a sample to show behaviour and look; data is mock. Do not copy prototype code into the product.
handoff.spec.imagesOnBoard: Screen images are on the Figma wireflow board: open the `figma` link of each screen in `screens/screens.json`.
